title: Create a 30-second 16:9 horizontal photorealistic travel vlog following an…
content:
Create a 30-second 16:9 horizontal photorealistic travel vlog following an energetic man in his late 20s to early 30s on a multi-day trip through three real Spanish locations: the Real Alcázar in Seville, San Juan de Gaztelugatxe on the Basque coast, and Girona’s medieval Old Town/Jewish Quarter.

Character: Same man throughout the entire video, casual travel outfit with T-shirt, cap, backpack and sunglasses. He films himself with a phone and speaks directly to the camera with genuine excitement. Natural facial expressions, realistic body movement and consistent appearance across every cut.

Visual style: Bright, warm, high-energy travel-vlog realism. Authentic handheld phone footage with slight shake, walking bounce and occasional imperfect framing, mixed with a few smooth establishing shots. Natural transitions, quick jump cuts and realistic travel-montage pacing. No subtitles, on-screen text, logos, show titles, distorted faces/hands, duplicated people or artificial influencer acting.

[0–5s] REAL ALCÁZAR — SEVILLE

Start with a handheld selfie shot as he enters the ornate tiled courtyard of the Real Alcázar. He smiles excitedly and turns the phone briefly toward the arches, fountains and reflecting pool.

Dialogue:
“Okay, stop number one—Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I’m here.”

Quick walking shot through the gardens and colorful tilework.

[5–10s] TRAVEL TRANSITION → GAZTELUGATXE

Fast montage of a train window, car dashboard, passing road and natural travel transitions. Cut to a dramatic wide shot of San Juan de Gaztelugatxe, showing the rocky coastline, winding stone staircase and ocean.

Dialogue:
“Fast forward a few hours north—this is the one I’ve been waiting for.”

[10–17s] GAZTELUGATXE CLIMB

Handheld footage follows him climbing the winding stone staircase with strong coastal wind and crashing waves below. His breathing becomes slightly heavier, but he remains excited.

Dialogue:
“This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah… if this place looks familiar, that’s exactly why I wanted to see it.”

Cut to a wider elevated perspective showing him small against the cliffs and huge ocean landscape.

Dialogue:
“Okay, this view. Worth every single step.”

[17–21s] TRAVEL MONTAGE → GIRONA

Quick realistic transition through road footage, passing scenery and a brief sunset shot. Cut into Girona's medieval Old Town during warm evening light.

Dialogue:
“Last stop—and honestly, one of my favorites, Girona.”

[21–27s] GIRONA OLD TOWN

Handheld walking shot through the narrow stone streets of Girona's Jewish Quarter. Tall medieval buildings press closely together as he looks around and occasionally points the camera toward architectural details.

Dialogue:
“These alleys are even narrower in person than they look on screen.”

Keep the movement spontaneous and documentary-like.

[27–30s] FINAL SELFIE

Return to a close handheld selfie shot. Evening light falls naturally across the stone walls behind him. His energy is calmer and more reflective after the journey.

Dialogue:
“Three cities, three completely different sides of Spain—and they’re all incredible. Where should I go next?”

He smiles, turns the camera toward the alley ahead and continues walking.

Audio: Natural phone microphone recording with accurate lip sync. Keep footsteps, wind, distant conversations, traffic and ocean waves audible where appropriate. No background music overpowering the dialogue. Dialogue should sound spontaneous and conversational rather than scripted.

Continuity: Maintain the exact same character identity, clothing, accessories and voice throughout all scenes. Each location should have its own visual signature: golden Seville, windswept coastal Gaztelugatxe, warm stone-and-shadow Girona. Preserve authentic handheld travel-vlog texture across the entire video.

es.content:
Crea un travel vlog fotorrealista de 30 segundos en formato horizontal 16:9 siguiendo a un hombre enérgico de finales de sus 20 a principios de sus 30 durante un viaje de varios días por tres ubicaciones reales de España: el Real Alcázar de Sevilla, San Juan de Gaztelugatxe en la costa vasca y el casco antiguo medieval / barrio judío de Girona.

Character: El mismo hombre durante todo el video, con un outfit casual de viaje: camiseta, gorra, mochila y gafas de sol. Se graba a sí mismo con un teléfono y habla directamente a la cámara con entusiasmo genuino. Expresiones faciales naturales, movimiento corporal realista y apariencia consistente en cada corte.

Visual style: Realismo de travel vlog brillante, cálido y de alta energía. Footage auténtico de teléfono en mano con ligera vibración, rebote al caminar y encuadres ocasionalmente imperfectos, mezclado con algunos planos generales suaves de establecimiento. Transiciones naturales, cortes rápidos tipo jump cut y un ritmo de montaje de viaje realista. Sin subtítulos, texto en pantalla, logos, títulos de programa, rostros/manos deformados, personas duplicadas ni actuación artificial de influencer.

[0–5s] REAL ALCÁZAR — SEVILLA

Empieza con un plano selfie en mano mientras entra en el ornamentado patio de azulejos del Real Alcázar. Sonríe con emoción y gira brevemente el teléfono hacia los arcos, las fuentes y el estanque reflectante.

Dialogue:
“Okay, stop number one—Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I’m here.”

Plano rápido caminando por los jardines y el colorido trabajo de azulejos.

[5–10s] TRAVEL TRANSITION → GAZTELUGATXE

Montaje rápido de la ventana de un tren, el tablero de un coche, la carretera pasando y transiciones naturales de viaje. Corte a un plano general dramático de San Juan de Gaztelugatxe, mostrando la costa rocosa, la escalera de piedra serpenteante y el océano.

Dialogue:
“Fast forward a few hours north—this is the one I’ve been waiting for.”

[10–17s] GAZTELUGATXE CLIMB

El footage en mano lo sigue mientras sube la escalera de piedra serpenteante con un fuerte viento costero y las olas rompiendo abajo. Su respiración se vuelve un poco más pesada, pero sigue emocionado.

Dialogue:
“This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah… if this place looks familiar, that’s exactly why I wanted to see it.”

Corte a una perspectiva más amplia y elevada que lo muestra pequeño frente a los acantilados y el inmenso paisaje oceánico.

Dialogue:
“Okay, this view. Worth every single step.”

[17–21s] TRAVEL MONTAGE → GIRONA

Transición rápida y realista a través de imágenes de carretera, paisajes que pasan y un breve plano al atardecer. Corte al casco antiguo medieval de Girona con la cálida luz de la tarde.

Dialogue:
“Last stop—and honestly, one of my favorites, Girona.”

[21–27s] GIRONA OLD TOWN

Plano caminando en mano por las estrechas calles de piedra del barrio judío de Girona. Altos edificios medievales se aprietan unos contra otros mientras él mira alrededor y, de vez en cuando, apunta la cámara hacia detalles arquitectónicos.

Dialogue:
“These alleys are even narrower in person than they look on screen.”

Mantén el movimiento espontáneo y con un estilo documental.

[27–30s] FINAL SELFIE

Vuelve a un plano selfie cercano en mano. La luz de la tarde cae de forma natural sobre las paredes de piedra detrás de él. Su energía es más calmada y reflexiva después del viaje.

Dialogue:
“Three cities, three completely different sides of Spain—and they’re all incredible. Where should I go next?”

Él sonríe, gira la cámara hacia el callejón que tiene delante y sigue caminando.

Audio: Grabación natural con micrófono de teléfono y sincronización labial precisa. Mantén audibles los pasos, el viento, conversaciones lejanas, tráfico y olas del océano cuando corresponda. Sin música de fondo que opaque el diálogo. El diálogo debe sonar espontáneo y conversacional, no guionizado.

Continuity: Mantén exactamente la misma identidad del personaje, ropa, accesorios y voz en todas las escenas. Cada ubicación debe tener su propia firma visual: el dorado de Sevilla, la costa azotada por el viento de Gaztelugatxe, la piedra cálida y las sombras de Girona. Conserva la textura auténtica de travel vlog en mano durante todo el video.

fr.content:
Créez un travel vlog photoréaliste de 30 secondes en format horizontal 16:9, suivant un homme énergique de la fin de la vingtaine au début de la trentaine lors d’un voyage de plusieurs jours à travers trois lieux espagnols réels : le Real Alcázar à Séville, San Juan de Gaztelugatxe sur la côte basque, et la vieille ville médiévale / quartier juif de Gérone.

Character: Même homme tout au long de la vidéo, tenue de voyage décontractée avec T-shirt, casquette, sac à dos et lunettes de soleil. Il se filme avec un téléphone et parle directement à la caméra avec un enthousiasme authentique. Expressions faciales naturelles, mouvements corporels réalistes et apparence cohérente à chaque coupe.

Visual style: Réalisme de travel vlog lumineux, chaleureux et très énergique. Images authentiques filmées à la main avec un téléphone, avec un léger tremblement, un rebond de marche et un cadrage parfois imparfait, mêlées à quelques plans d’établissement fluides. Transitions naturelles, jump cuts rapides et rythme de montage de voyage réaliste. Pas de sous-titres, pas de texte à l’écran, pas de logos, pas de titres d’émission, pas de visages/mains déformés, pas de personnes dupliquées ni de jeu artificiel d’influenceur.

[0–5s] REAL ALCÁZAR — SEVILLE

Commencez par un selfie shot tenu à la main alors qu’il entre dans la cour ornée de carreaux du Real Alcázar. Il sourit avec excitation et oriente brièvement le téléphone vers les arches, les fontaines et le bassin réfléchissant.

Dialogue:
“Okay, stop number one—Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I’m here.”

Plan de marche rapide à travers les jardins et les mosaïques colorées.

[5–10s] TRAVEL TRANSITION → GAZTELUGATXE

Montage rapide d’une fenêtre de train, du tableau de bord d’une voiture, de la route qui défile et de transitions de voyage naturelles. Coupe vers un plan large spectaculaire de San Juan de Gaztelugatxe, montrant la côte rocheuse, l’escalier de pierre sinueux et l’océan.

Dialogue:
“Fast forward a few hours north—this is the one I’ve been waiting for.”

[10–17s] GAZTELUGATXE CLIMB

Des images filmées à la main le suivent en train de monter l’escalier de pierre sinueux, avec un fort vent côtier et les vagues qui se brisent en contrebas. Sa respiration devient légèrement plus lourde, mais il reste enthousiaste.

Dialogue:
“This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah… if this place looks familiar, that’s exactly why I wanted to see it.”

Coupez vers une perspective plus large et surélevée le montrant minuscule face aux falaises et à l’immense paysage océanique.

Dialogue:
“Okay, this view. Worth every single step.”

[17–21s] TRAVEL MONTAGE → GIRONA

Transition rapide à travers des images de route, des paysages qui défilent et un bref plan au coucher du soleil. Coupe vers la vieille ville médiévale de Gérone dans la lumière chaude du soir.

Dialogue:
“Last stop—and honestly, one of my favorites, Girona.”

[21–27s] GIRONA OLD TOWN

Plan de marche filmé à la main dans les ruelles étroites en pierre du quartier juif de Gérone. De hauts bâtiments médiévaux se resserrent de part et d’autre tandis qu’il regarde autour de lui et pointe parfois la caméra vers des détails architecturaux.

Dialogue:
“These alleys are even narrower in person than they look on screen.”

Gardez un mouvement spontané et de type documentaire.

[27–30s] FINAL SELFIE

Retour à un gros plan selfie tenu à la main. La lumière du soir tombe naturellement sur les murs de pierre derrière lui. Son énergie est plus calme et plus contemplative après le voyage.

Dialogue:
“Three cities, three completely different sides of Spain—and they’re all incredible. Where should I go next?”

Il sourit, tourne la caméra vers la ruelle devant lui et continue de marcher.

Audio: Enregistrement naturel au micro du téléphone avec une synchronisation labiale précise. Conservez les pas, le vent, les conversations lointaines, la circulation et les vagues de l’océan audibles lorsque c’est approprié. Pas de musique de fond qui couvre la dialogue. Le dialogue doit sembler spontané et conversationnel plutôt que scénarisé.

Continuity: Maintenez exactement la même identité de personnage, les mêmes vêtements, accessoires et la même voix dans toutes les scènes. Chaque lieu doit avoir sa propre signature visuelle : Séville dorée, Gaztelugatxe balayé par les vents sur la côte, Gérone en pierre chaude et ombres marquées. Préservez la texture authentique de travel vlog filmé à la main sur l’ensemble de la vidéo.

ja.content:
30秒の16:9横長のフォトリアルなトラベルVlogを作成してください。元気な20代後半から30代前半の男性が、スペインの実在する3つのロケーションを巡る数日間の旅を追います。場所は、セビリアのレアル・アルカサル、バスク海岸のサン・ファン・デ・ガステルガチェ、そしてジローナの中世旧市街／ユダヤ人街です。

Character: 動画全編を通して同一人物。Tシャツ、キャップ、バックパック、サングラスのカジュアルな旅スタイル。スマホで自撮りしながら、心からの興奮を込めてカメラに直接話しかける。自然な表情、リアルな身体の動き、どのカットでも一貫した見た目を維持すること。

Visual style: 明るく、温かく、ハイエナジーなトラベルVlogのリアリズム。わずかな手ブレ、歩行時の揺れ、時折の不完全なフレーミングを伴う本物の手持ちスマホ映像に、いくつかの滑らかな establishing shot を混ぜる。自然なトランジション、素早いジャンプカット、リアルな旅モンタージュのテンポ。字幕、画面上のテキスト、ロゴ、番組タイトル、歪んだ顔や手、重複した人物、人工的なインフルエンサー演技はなし。

[0–5s] REAL ALCÁZAR — SEVILLE

レアル・アルカサルの装飾的なタイル張りの中庭に入るところから、手持ちの自撮りショットで始める。彼は興奮して笑い、スマホを一瞬アーチ、噴水、反射池のほうへ向ける。

Dialogue:
“Okay, stop number one—Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I’m here.”

庭園や色鮮やかなタイル装飾の中を歩く短いショット。

[5–10s] TRAVEL TRANSITION → GAZTELUGATXE

列車の窓、車のダッシュボード、通り過ぎる道路、自然な旅のトランジションを使った高速モンタージュ。サン・ファン・デ・ガステルガチェのドラマチックなワイドショットに切り替え、岩だらけの海岸線、曲がりくねった石段、海を見せる。

Dialogue:
“Fast forward a few hours north—this is the one I’ve been waiting for.”

[10–17s] GAZTELUGATXE CLIMB

手持ち映像で、強い海風と下で砕ける波の中、曲がりくねった石段を登る彼を追う。息は少し上がるが、興奮はそのまま。

Dialogue:
“This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah… if this place looks familiar, that’s exactly why I wanted to see it.”

より高い位置からの広い視点に切り替え、彼が断崖と巨大な海の風景の中で小さく見えるようにする。

Dialogue:
“Okay, this view. Worth every single step.”

[17–21s] TRAVEL MONTAGE → GIRONA

道路映像、流れる景色、短い夕景ショットを使った素早くリアルなトランジション。ジローナの中世旧市街へ、暖かな夕方の光の中で切り込む。

Dialogue:
“Last stop—and honestly, one of my favorites, Girona.”

[21–27s] GIRONA OLD TOWN

ジローナのユダヤ人街の細い石畳の通りを歩く手持ちショット。高い中世建築が密集し、彼は周囲を見回しながら、ときどき建築のディテールに向けてカメラを指さす。

Dialogue:
“These alleys are even narrower in person than they look on screen.”

動きは自然発生的で、ドキュメンタリーのようにすること。

[27–30s] FINAL SELFIE

最後は、近距離の手持ち自撮りショットに戻る。旅を終えた彼の背後の石壁に、夕方の光が自然に差し込む。エネルギーは少し落ち着き、より内省的になっている。

Dialogue:
“Three cities, three completely different sides of Spain—and they’re all incredible. Where should I go next?”

彼は笑い、カメラを先の路地へ向けて、そのまま歩き続ける。

Audio: 自然なスマホマイク録音で、口の動きと正確に同期させること。適切な場面では、足音、風、遠くの会話、交通音、海の波を聞こえるようにする。BGMが会話をかき消さないようにする。セリフは台本っぽくなく、自然で会話的に聞こえること。

Continuity: すべてのシーンで、まったく同じキャラクターのアイデンティティ、服装、アクセサリー、声を維持すること。各ロケーションにはそれぞれ固有のビジュアルシグネチャーを持たせること：黄金色のセビリア、風にさらされた海岸のガステルガチェ、温かみのある石と影のジローナ。動画全体を通して、本物の手持ちトラベルVlogの質感を保つこと。

ko.content:
30초 길이의 16:9 가로형 포토리얼리스틱 여행 브이로그를 만들어 주세요. 에너지 넘치는 20대 후반에서 30대 초반의 남성이 스페인의 실제 세 곳을 며칠에 걸쳐 여행하는 모습을 따라갑니다: 세비야의 레알 알카사르, 바스크 해안의 산 후안 데 가스텔루가체, 그리고 지로나의 중세 구시가지/유대인 지구.

캐릭터: 영상 전체에서 동일한 남성. T셔츠, 캡, 백팩, 선글라스를 착용한 캐주얼한 여행 복장. 그는 휴대폰으로 셀카를 찍으며 카메라를 향해 진심 어린 흥분을 담아 직접 말합니다. 자연스러운 표정, 현실적인 몸짓, 그리고 모든 컷에서 일관된 외형을 유지합니다.

비주얼 스타일: 밝고 따뜻하며 에너지가 높은 여행 브이로그 리얼리즘. 약간의 흔들림, 걸을 때의 바운스, 가끔씩 완벽하지 않은 구도까지 포함한 진짜 휴대폰 핸드헬드 영상과, 몇 개의 부드러운 establishing shot을 섞습니다. 자연스러운 전환, 빠른 점프 컷, 현실적인 여행 몽타주 템포. 자막, 화면 텍스트, 로고, 쇼 타이틀, 일그러진 얼굴/손, 중복된 인물, 인위적인 인플루언서 연기는 없습니다.

[0–5초] 레알 알카사르 — 세비야

레알 알카사르의 화려한 타일 안뜰로 들어서는 순간을 핸드헬드 셀카 샷으로 시작합니다. 그는 신나게 미소 짓고, 잠시 휴대폰을 아치, 분수, 반사 수영장 쪽으로 돌립니다.

대사:
“Okay, stop number one—Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I’m here.”

정원과 다채로운 타일 장식을 지나가는 짧은 워킹 샷.

[5–10초] 여행 전환 → 가스텔루가체

기차 창문, 자동차 대시보드, 지나가는 도로, 자연스러운 여행 전환의 빠른 몽타주. 이어서 산 후안 데 가스텔루가체의 극적인 와이드 샷으로 전환되며, 바위 해안선, 구불구불한 돌계단, 바다가 보입니다.

대사:
“Fast forward a few hours north—this is the one I’ve been waiting for.”

[10–17초] 가스텔루가체 오르기

핸드헬드 영상이 그가 구불구불한 돌계단을 오르는 모습을 따라갑니다. 강한 해안 바람과 아래에서 부서지는 파도가 느껴집니다. 숨이 약간 가빠지지만, 그는 여전히 들떠 있습니다.

대사:
“This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah… if this place looks familiar, that’s exactly why I wanted to see it.”

더 넓고 높은 시점으로 전환해, 그가 절벽과 거대한 바다 풍경 속에서 작게 보이도록 보여줍니다.

대사:
“Okay, this view. Worth every single step.”

[17–21초] 여행 몽타주 → 지로나

도로 영상, 지나가는 풍경, 짧은 석양 샷으로 빠르게 전환합니다. 이어서 따뜻한 저녁빛 속의 지로나 중세 구시가지로 들어갑니다.

대사:
“Last stop—and honestly, one of my favorites, Girona.”

[21–27초] 지로나 구시가지

지로나 유대인 지구의 좁은 돌길을 따라가는 핸드헬드 워킹 샷. 높은 중세 건물들이 가까이 밀집해 있고, 그는 주변을 둘러보며 때때로 카메라를 건축 디테일 쪽으로 가리킵니다.

대사:
“These alleys are even narrower in person than they look on screen.”

움직임은 즉흥적이고 다큐멘터리 같은 느낌을 유지합니다.

[27–30초] 마지막 셀카

가까운 핸드헬드 셀카 샷으로 돌아옵니다. 저녁빛이 그의 뒤편 돌벽 위로 자연스럽게 내려앉습니다. 여정이 끝난 뒤 그의 에너지는 조금 더 차분하고 사색적으로 바뀝니다.

대사:
“Three cities, three completely different sides of Spain—and they’re all incredible. Where should I go next?”

그는 미소 짓고, 카메라를 앞의 골목 쪽으로 돌린 뒤 계속 걸어갑니다.

오디오: 자연스러운 휴대폰 마이크 녹음으로, 정확한 립싱크를 유지합니다. 적절한 구간에서는 발걸음 소리, 바람, 멀리서 들리는 대화, 교통 소음, 바다 파도 소리가 들리게 합니다. 배경음악이 대사를 압도하지 않도록 합니다. 대사는 각본처럼 들리기보다 즉흥적이고 대화체처럼 들려야 합니다.

연속성: 모든 장면에서 동일한 캐릭터 정체성, 의상, 액세서리, 목소리를 정확히 유지합니다. 각 장소는 고유한 시각적 특징을 가져야 합니다: 황금빛 세비야, 바람에 휩쓸린 해안의 가스텔루가체, 따뜻한 돌과 그림자의 지로나. 영상 전체에 걸쳐 진짜 핸드헬드 여행 브이로그의 질감을 유지합니다.

pt.content:
Crie um travel vlog fotorrealista de 30 segundos em formato horizontal 16:9, acompanhando um homem energético no fim dos 20 e início dos 30 anos em uma viagem de vários dias por três locais reais da Espanha: o Real Alcázar em Sevilha, San Juan de Gaztelugatxe na costa basca e o Centro Histórico medieval/Bairro Judeu de Girona.

Character: O mesmo homem durante todo o vídeo, com roupa casual de viagem — camiseta, boné, mochila e óculos de sol. Ele se filma com um celular e fala diretamente para a câmera com entusiasmo genuíno. Expressões faciais naturais, movimentos corporais realistas e aparência consistente em todos os cortes.

Visual style: Realismo de travel vlog brilhante, quente e de alta energia. Filmagem autêntica de celular na mão, com leve tremor, balanço ao caminhar e enquadramento ocasionalmente imperfeito, misturada com algumas tomadas de abertura suaves. Transições naturais, cortes rápidos e ritmo realista de montagem de viagem. Sem legendas, texto na tela, logos, títulos de programas, rostos/mãos distorcidos, pessoas duplicadas ou atuação artificial de influencer.

[0–5s] REAL ALCÁZAR — SEVILHA

Comece com uma selfie em handheld enquanto ele entra no pátio ornamentado e revestido de azulejos do Real Alcázar. Ele sorri animado e vira o celular brevemente para os arcos, as fontes e o espelho d’água.

Dialogue:
“Okay, stop number one—Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I’m here.”

Plano rápido caminhando pelos jardins e pelos azulejos coloridos.

[5–10s] TRAVEL TRANSITION → GAZTELUGATXE

Montagem rápida de uma janela de trem, painel de carro, estrada passando e transições naturais de viagem. Corte para uma tomada ampla e dramática de San Juan de Gaztelugatxe, mostrando a costa rochosa, a escadaria de pedra sinuosa e o oceano.

Dialogue:
“Fast forward a few hours north—this is the one I’ve been waiting for.”

[10–17s] GAZTELUGATXE CLIMB

A filmagem em handheld acompanha ele subindo a escadaria de pedra sinuosa com vento costeiro forte e ondas quebrando abaixo. A respiração fica um pouco mais pesada, mas ele continua animado.

Dialogue:
“This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah… if this place looks familiar, that’s exactly why I wanted to see it.”

Corte para uma perspectiva mais ampla e elevada, mostrando-o pequeno contra os penhascos e a imensa paisagem oceânica.

Dialogue:
“Okay, this view. Worth every single step.”

[17–21s] TRAVEL MONTAGE → GIRONA

Transição rápida e realista com imagens da estrada, paisagens passando e uma breve tomada ao pôr do sol. Corte para o Centro Histórico medieval de Girona sob a luz quente do fim de tarde.

Dialogue:
“Last stop—and honestly, one of my favorites, Girona.”

[21–27s] GIRONA OLD TOWN

Plano em handheld caminhando pelas ruas estreitas de pedra do Bairro Judeu de Girona. Prédios medievais altos se comprimem de perto enquanto ele olha ao redor e, ocasionalmente, aponta a câmera para detalhes arquitetônicos.

Dialogue:
“These alleys are even narrower in person than they look on screen.”

Mantenha o movimento espontâneo e com aparência documental.

[27–30s] FINAL SELFIE

Volte para uma selfie próxima em handheld. A luz do fim de tarde cai naturalmente sobre as paredes de pedra atrás dele. Sua energia está mais calma e reflexiva após a viagem.

Dialogue:
“Three cities, three completely different sides of Spain—and they’re all incredible. Where should I go next?”

Ele sorri, vira a câmera para o beco à frente e continua andando.

Audio: Gravação natural pelo microfone do celular com sincronização labial precisa. Mantenha passos, vento, conversas distantes, tráfego e ondas do oceano audíveis quando apropriado. Sem música de fundo abafando o diálogo. O diálogo deve soar espontâneo e conversacional, e não roteirizado.

Continuity: Mantenha a mesma identidade exata do personagem, roupa, acessórios e voz em todas as cenas. Cada local deve ter sua própria assinatura visual: Sevilha dourada, Gaztelugatxe costeira e castigada pelo vento, Girona em pedra quente e sombras. Preserve a textura autêntica de travel vlog em handheld ao longo de todo o vídeo.

zh.content:
创建一个30秒、16:9横向、写实风格的旅行 vlog，跟随一位20多岁末到30岁初、精力充沛的男性，记录他为期数天的西班牙三地之旅：塞维利亚的皇家阿尔卡萨（Real Alcázar）、巴斯克海岸的圣胡安·德·加斯特鲁加特谢（San Juan de Gaztelugatxe），以及赫罗纳（Girona）的中世纪老城区/犹太区。

角色：整段视频中始终是同一个男人，穿着休闲旅行装：T 恤、帽子、背包和太阳镜。他用手机自拍，并带着真切的兴奋感直接对着镜头说话。面部表情自然，身体动作真实，每个镜头切换时外观保持一致。

视觉风格：明亮、温暖、高能量的旅行 vlog 写实风格。真实的手持手机画面，带轻微晃动、走路时的起伏感和偶尔不完美的构图，并混合少量平稳的建立镜头。自然转场、快速跳切和真实的旅行蒙太奇节奏。不要字幕、屏幕文字、logo、节目标题、扭曲的脸/手、重复人物或人工网红式表演。

[0–5s] REAL ALCÁZAR — SEVILLE

以手持自拍镜头开始，他走进皇家阿尔卡萨华丽的瓷砖庭院。他兴奋地微笑，并短暂把手机转向拱门、喷泉和倒影池。

对白：
“Okay, stop number one—Seville, the Real Alcázar. If you know your fantasy shows, you already know why I’m here.”

快速行走镜头穿过花园和色彩鲜艳的瓷砖装饰。

[5–10s] TRAVEL TRANSITION → GAZTELUGATXE

火车车窗、汽车仪表台、沿途道路和自然旅行转场的快速蒙太奇。切到圣胡安·德·加斯特鲁加特谢的戏剧性远景，展现岩石海岸线、蜿蜒的石阶和海洋。

对白：
“Fast forward a few hours north—this is the one I’ve been waiting for.”

[10–17s] GAZTELUGATXE CLIMB

手持画面跟随他沿着蜿蜒的石阶攀登，海风强劲，脚下海浪拍岸。他的呼吸略微加重，但依然兴奋。

对白：
“This bridge has over 200 steps, and yeah… if this place looks familiar, that’s exactly why I wanted to see it.”

切到更高、更宽的视角，显示他在悬崖和辽阔海景前显得很渺小。

对白：
“Okay, this view. Worth every single step.”

[17–21s] TRAVEL MONTAGE → GIRONA

通过道路画面、掠过的风景和一小段日落镜头进行快速、真实的转场。切入赫罗纳中世纪老城区的温暖傍晚光线。

对白：
“Last stop—and honestly, one of my favorites, Girona.”

[21–27s] GIRONA OLD TOWN

手持行走镜头穿过赫罗纳犹太区狭窄的石板街道。高耸的中世纪建筑紧密相连，他四处张望，并不时把镜头指向建筑细节。

对白：
“These alleys are even narrower in person than they look on screen.”

保持动作自然、即兴，带有纪录片感。

[27–30s] FINAL SELFIE

回到近景手持自拍镜头。傍晚的光线自然洒在他身后的石墙上。经历这段旅程后，他的情绪更平静，也更有感触。

对白：
“Three cities, three completely different sides of Spain—and they’re all incredible. Where should I go next?”

他微笑着，把镜头转向前方的小巷，继续往前走。

音频：使用自然的手机麦克风录音，并确保口型同步准确。在适当的地方保留脚步声、风声、远处的交谈声、交通声和海浪声。不要让背景音乐盖过对白。对白应听起来自然随意，而不是像事先写好的台词。

连贯性：在所有场景中保持完全相同的角色身份、服装、配饰和声音。每个地点都应有各自鲜明的视觉特征：塞维利亚的金色光感、加斯特鲁加特谢的海风海岸、赫罗纳的暖色石墙与阴影。整个视频都要保留真实的手持旅行 vlog 质感。
